events.name: Cinnabar Lab: The Fossil Machine
events.intro: A big glass machine fills the back of the lab. A scientist waves you over. "Two fossil halves make a whole. I can revive any whole fossil."

choices.label: Show the Mt. Moon fossil log

success.text: "A registered find from Mt. Moon! Take this: half of a fossil."
"I have a piece that fits yours."
The scientist fits the two halves together. A whole fossil, and the machine is already humming.
You step back from the machine.

events.name: Cinnabar Lab: Lab Trades
events.intro: A scientist tinkers with a trading cable. "A fair swap, my friend. A Pokémon for a Pokémon."

choices.label: Trade an unevolved Pokémon for a Voltorb

success.text: The cable sparks. A Voltorb rolls into your arms.

choices.label: Trade a middle-stage Pokémon for an Electrode

success.text: The cable sparks. An Electrode hums in your hands.

choices.label: Trade a fully evolved Pokémon for a Porygon

success.text: The cable sparks. A Porygon blinks into existence.
You pocket your Pokémon.

events.name: Cinnabar Lab: Pokémon Fusion Display
events.intro: Glass tubes line a wall, each showing two Pokémon blurred into one. A plaque reads: "Do not touch."

success.text: Fusions of every kind drift past. None of them look happy, and none of them are real. You file that away.

effects.text: Saw the Pokémon Fusion Display at the Cinnabar Lab.

success.text: You leave the tubes alone.

events.name: Cinnabar Lab
events.intro: A white building on a volcanic island, humming with machines. Scientists in coats hurry past with clipboards.

success.text: A scientist leads you to the back of the lab.
A scientist waves you over to a trading cable.
You wander over to the glass tubes.
You head back out to the shore.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion
events.intro: A burned-out mansion on the hill. Charred beams, cracked statues, a smell of old smoke. You can turn back before the first fight.

success.text: The door gives way with a groan.
You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Burned Hall
events.intro: Soot covers the floor. Something moves under a fallen chandelier.

success.text: A wild shape slinks out of the ash.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Library
events.intro: Burnt shelves and a scorched desk. A diary page lies under a paperweight.

success.text: Page 1: "Our team has found a rare Pokémon in the jungle. The Boss wants it studied at once." You learn something.
You leave the page where it lies.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Statue Room
events.intro: Cracked stone statues of Pokémon line the walls. One of them is looking at you.

success.text: The "statue" was a Pokémon after all.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Study
events.intro: A locked study, its desk drawer open. Another diary page, folded small.

success.text: Page 2: "We have bred it from the fossil of a Pokémon we call Mew. The new one is stronger. We named it Mewtwo." You learn something.
You leave the page where it lies.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Switches: step 1 of 3
events.intro: Three switches in the wall. One of them opens the secret door. The others spit sparks.

success.text: Click. A hidden door slides open.
Sparks! The wrong switch shocks you and resets the wall.
Sparks! The wrong switch shocks you and resets the wall.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Secret Door
events.intro: A bare wall in the back of the mansion. A page of the diary is stuck to a switch panel.

choices.label: Read the page and try the switches

success.text: Page 3: "It is growing too fast. It does not like us. It does not like anything." You learn something, then reach for the switches.
You ignore the page and reach for the switches.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Last Scientist
events.intro: Behind the secret door, a Rocket scientist is burning papers. "You were not supposed to find this place!"

success.text: He throws a Poké Ball.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Last Page
events.intro: The scientist dropped one more diary page as he ran.

success.text: Page 4: "Mewtwo has escaped and the lab is lost. The Boss says this never happened. He will hide behind his gym, and no one will ask." You learn something.

effects.text: Found the last Mansion diary page: the Boss's gym is a cover.

success.text: You leave the page where it lies.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Locker
events.intro: A locker in the burned wall holds two prizes. You can take only one.

success.text: The TM is warm in your hand.
A fossil, still warm from the fire.

events.name: Seafoam Islands
events.intro: An icy cave under the sea cliffs, with strong currents tugging at the rocks. You can turn back before the first fight.

success.text: Cold air and rushing water.
You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Cave Mouth
events.intro: Ice glitters on the walls. Something splashes in the dark.

success.text: A wild shape surges out of the water.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Frozen Shore
events.intro: Cold wind and a fast current. A boulder sits in front of a hole in the floor.

success.text: Three boulders, three holes. If you plug them right, the current stops.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Boulders: step 1 of 3
events.intro: Two boulders block the way, and only one of them fits the first hole.

success.text: The boulder drops into the hole. The current weakens.
The boulder rolls the wrong way and the current drags you back, bruised.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Boulders: step 2 of 3
events.intro: The second hole. The current is stronger here.

success.text: Another hole plugged. The water slows to a trickle.
The boulder rolls the wrong way and the current drags you back, bruised.

success.text: The last hole plugs. The current stops, and the way down is clear.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Still Water
events.intro: The current is gone. Ice bridges and a frozen pool. Something big watches from the water.

success.text: A wild shape comes up for air.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Ice Slope
events.intro: A long slope of ice leads down. Your footsteps ring in the cold.

success.text: A wild shape slides up to meet you.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Bottom
events.intro: The deepest chamber. The air hums with cold, and a big shape coils in the mist.

success.text: It is a legendary bird of ice.

failure.text: It is only a herd of Dewgong, and they do not like visitors.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: Articuno
events.intro: Articuno spreads its blue wings. The cave glitters like a thousand mirrors.

success.text: Its feathers are dark and sharp: a Galarian Articuno.

failure.text: The legendary bird of ice lowers its head to fight.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Dewgong Herd
events.intro: A wall of white fur. The Dewgong block the way down.

success.text: The herd charges, one after another.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Way Out
events.intro: A narrow tunnel leads up to the sunlight. Something glitters in the ice by the exit.

choices.label: Take the Never-Melt Ice and Icy Rock

success.text: Two pieces of ice that never melt, even in your hand.

events.name: New Island
events.intro: A mysterious invitation arrives: a boat, an island castle, a host who will not give a name. A storm is rolling in. You can still say no.

success.text: The boat leaves the shore in the rain.
You turn back. Nothing here is forced.

events.name: New Island: The Storm
events.intro: Thunder cracks over the water. The boat tosses, and something rides the wind beside it.

success.text: A wild shape swoops out of the storm.

events.name: New Island: The Castle
events.intro: A grand castle sits on the rock. A voice from a hidden speaker: "Welcome. Tonight, the strongest become the first of a new kind."

success.text: The doors close behind you.

events.name: New Island: The Clone Laboratory
events.intro: Rows of glowing tanks. In each, a Pokémon that looks just like one of yours. The host says: "These are your copies, and they are better."

success.text: The tanks open. Your own Pokémon step out, with no abilities and no heart.

lose.text: Was scanned by the clones of New Island.

events.name: New Island: The Clone Core
events.intro: The tanks go dark. In the wreckage, a small glowing core that still hums.

success.text: The core copies your lead's moves onto your lowest-level Pokémon. Then it burns out.
You leave it humming in the dark.

events.name: New Island: The Mew Sighting
events.intro: On the roof, rain slackening. A small pink shape floats at the edge of the light.

success.text: It turns around and meets your eyes.

failure.text: Gone. It was only a trick of the storm. Or was it?

effects.text: Saw a pink shape on New Island.

success.text: The boat takes you home. Some secrets are not for you.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano
events.intro: A trail climbs the smoking volcano. Burn Heal herbs grow near the top, and so do their keepers.

success.text: The ground is warm under your feet.
Not today.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Lower Slope
events.intro: Heat shimmers over cracked black rock.

success.text: You pick your way over the hot rock.

failure.text: A gout of fire catches your lead.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Ash Field
events.intro: Ash drifts down like grey snow. Steam hisses from vents.

success.text: You pick your way over the hot rock.

failure.text: A gout of fire catches your lead.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Herb Ledge
events.intro: On a ledge above the lava, a patch of red herbs grows in the heat.

success.text: You pick a handful of Burn Heal herbs.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Last Climb
events.intro: The summit is close. The air glows.

success.text: You pick your way over the hot rock.

failure.text: A gout of fire catches your lead.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Summit
events.intro: At the crater's rim, a fiery shape guards the last of the herbs.

success.text: It lunges out of the smoke.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Crater Rim
events.intro: Fire Stone glints in the rock, and a Heat Rock lies warm beside it.

success.text: The stones are hot, but they will keep.
